maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new-project sales of heat tracing, heaters, boilers and controls for capital projects; maintenance/MRO is a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial firms in oil and gas, chemicals, power and data centers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own heat tracing and heating product sales; only occasional acquisitions such as boiler businesses.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered heat tracing and heaters are specified into hazardous-area process facilities; freeze protection failure and requalification make switching costly.

notes: Maintenance share of revenue is uncertain; company has both new-build project and maintenance/MRO sales.
